title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum on 1989-12-30
source: flac16/48kHz; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master (FOB)Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC3/MK4 mics > Aerco PreAmp (w/ Oade capacitor mod)> Panasonic SV-250 (16-bit/48k); Transfer Info: Master Dat (Sony PCM-R500)> Tascam DA-3000 (16-bit/48k) > .wav(16-bit/48k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH 1648

ai_review.summary: A solid Oakland Coliseum show with strong sets and a clear front‑of‑house recording that fans rate as one of the better FOB sources.
ai_review.review: The concert delivers two tight, energetic sets – a rock‑filled first set highlighted by Bertha > Good Lovin' and a second set that kicks off with Jack Straw and rolls through a well‑executed C.Cat > Rider into Estimated > Terrapin.  The front‑of‑house (FOB) recording is praised for its clarity, good rigging and minimal crowd bleed, making it one of the more listenable audience mixes from the Coliseum.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 4‑star ratings and highlighted a solid musical performance plus a good‑quality FOB recording; with limited review count the rating reflects strong show quality (≈70%) and decent audio quality (≈30%).

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house mix is clear with a well‑balanced rig; slight PA feedback and occasional hand claps noted, but overall a pleasant and listenable recording for the Coliseum venue.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is solid and rock‑driven, second set ramps up the energy with a classic opener and tight transitions between Cat > Rider and Estimated > Terrapin, giving the concert a strong forward momentum.
